title: Eternal Loop of Dreams
description: Two dark-skinned figures stand in the foreground, one with golden eyes and the other with glowing purple eyes and horns, wrapped together by a large turquoise and gold serpentine dragon forming an infinity loop. In the background, an astronaut floats in space smoking a pipe while a robed wizard with a glowing orb sits atop the horned figure's head, overlooking a fantasy landscape with mountains, a river, and a distant castle under a starry twilight sky. A wooden sign in the bottom right reads 'THE END'.
prompt: Surreal fantasy scene with two dark-skinned figures in the foreground, one with golden eyes and the other with horns and glowing purple eyes, entwined by a large turquoise and gold patterned dragon forming an infinity symbol. A wizard in blue robes with a glowing orb sits on the horned figure's head while an astronaut in a white spacesuit floats in the upper right smoking a pipe with smoke forming magical symbols. Distant fantasy castle in a mountain valley with a winding river, under a starry purple twilight sky with crescent moon. Wooden sign in corner reads 'THE END'. Intricate details, cinematic lighting.
